decisions.chosen: PRs opened, PRs merged, commits (GitHub Search API total_count)
decisions.detail: user: metric 4 is GitHub PRs / commits; docs/metrics.md names the Search API `is:pr created:<day>`

decisions.chosen: UTC day, first to last second
decisions.detail: config.py: all days in this study are UTC days

decisions.chosen: same activity, same weekday 7 calendar days earlier (date join); NULL when either day is missing
decisions.detail: user, 20 Nov: add the previous Thursdays as context and highlight the drop; the headline compares with the Thursday before the same way

notes: the last comparison did not establish the results were kept or changed only as expected for: fct_github_daily (unexpected_change)

--- a/models/marts/fct_github_daily.sql
+++ b/models/marts/fct_github_daily.sql
@@ -1,21 +1,34 @@
 -- Metric 4: GitHub activity per UTC day. One row per day per activity, for every day asked
--- for (release day, the weeks before it and the weeks after it).
+-- for (release day, the weeks before it and the weeks after it), with the same weekday a week
+-- earlier beside it (a date join, not a row offset, so a missing day cannot shift the pairing).
 {%- set release_day = var('github_release_day') %}
+with daily as (
+    select * from {{ ref('stg_github__daily_counts') }}
+)
+
 select
-    md5(activity || '|' || cast(activity_date as varchar)) as github_day_key,
-    activity_date,
-    activity,
-    case activity
+    md5(daily.activity || '|' || cast(daily.activity_date as varchar)) as github_day_key,
+    daily.activity_date,
+    daily.activity,
+    case daily.activity
         when 'prs_opened' then 'PRs opened'
         when 'prs_merged' then 'PRs merged'
         when 'commits' then 'Commits'
-        else activity
+        else daily.activity
     end as activity_label,
-    activity_count,
-    is_available,
-    dayname(activity_date) as weekday_name,
-    activity_date = date '{{ release_day }}' as is_release_day,
-    cast(date_diff('day', date '{{ release_day }}', activity_date) as integer)
+    daily.activity_count,
+    daily.is_available,
+    dayname(daily.activity_date) as weekday_name,
+    daily.activity_date = date '{{ release_day }}' as is_release_day,
+    cast(date_diff('day', date '{{ release_day }}', daily.activity_date) as integer)
         as days_from_release,
-    observed_at
-from {{ ref('stg_github__daily_counts') }}
+    daily.observed_at,
+    week_before.activity_count as prior_week_count,
+    case
+        when daily.activity_count is not null and week_before.activity_count > 0
+            then 100 * (daily.activity_count / week_before.activity_count - 1)
+    end as wow_pct_change
+from daily
+left join daily as week_before
+    on daily.activity = week_before.activity
+    and week_before.activity_date = cast(daily.activity_date - 7 as date)
